svg.title: Hindsight
svg.desc: AI-powered operational memory and incident resolution platform. Gemini LLMs and RAG on Node.js, Prisma, and PostgreSQL automate real-time incident resolution as a production-grade cloud service. pgvector semantic search with cosine similarity across incident logs cut resolution time by 40%. Server-Sent Events stream generated answers live, secured with token-based JWT authentication.
svg.text: AI-POWERED OPERATIONAL MEMORY AND INCIDENT RESOLUTION PLATFORM
Gemini LLMs and RAG on Node.js, Prisma, and PostgreSQL automate real-time incident resolution as
pgvector semantic search with cosine similarity across incident logs cut resolution time by 40%.
Server-Sent Events stream generated answers live, secured with token-based JWT authentication.
